style: Black and electric blue. High-contrast geometric brand sting: sharp rectangular planes, decisive perspective, snap acceleration, generous negative space. Motion carries the message; typography is only the final identity.
shot_brief: Blue slivers cut across a near-black field on a musical electronic pulse. Rectangular planes swivel and converge into one hollow screen aperture. The aperture rushes toward camera and becomes a blue full-frame impact; agent-render lands large in white, then the field snaps back to black with a small blue aperture beside the centered identity. Hold the finished brand for the last second as the music resolves. No interface, code, features, or explanatory copy.

customize.layout: 1600x900, centered identity, 110px edge safety, 180px brand type; screen aperture uses a 16:9 proportion and thick flat blue edges.

customize.panel-reveal: Reuse timeline and height expansion mechanics for four blue rectangular planes. Remove all example content. Their shared negative space becomes an empty screen aperture.
customize.ui-3d-reveal: Reuse seek-safe perspective arrival for the abstract plane group. The slotted content is flat geometry only. Limit tilt to 25 degrees and favor large simple silhouettes.
customize.logo-brand-close: Use the actual string agent-render, Inter heavy, white. Remove tagline, URL, punctuation additions and any CTA. Land text at 2.0; switch full blue field back to black at 2.5; settle the final blue aperture + white wordmark by 3.0 and hold still.

scenes.motion: Visible blue slivers begin already on screen at t=0. Opposed planes slash inward with tight power4.out deceleration at 0 and 0.5. They share one rectangular motif; no confetti or random particles.

Four blue planes snap into a hollow 16:9 aperture at 1.0; settle for 0.2s. At 1.5 the aperture rotates to face camera and surges forward until blue fills the frame at 1.9. Keep a real negative-space hole visible during assembly.

Large white brand lands on blue at 2.0 using logo-brand-close letter cascade compressed to 0.22s; no excess bounce. At 2.5 snap the background to black while the geometry resolves into a small blue aperture left of the wordmark. All translation finishes by 3.0.
Hold the centered blue aperture plus white brand still for one full second. Musical tonic resolves at 3.0, short warm tail ends cleanly at 4.0. No visual fade to black.

audio.direction: Tonal plucked synth motif, tight low kick/sub pulse, brief stereo air on the aperture rush, resolved chord at 3s with controlled tail. Music, not only whooshes. No voice. Parent sources final audio.
